rationale: The decorative paper outline exists in stable v1.82.0. Remove this weak visual effect and its rendering work by owner decision; preserve the environment and opaque paper. Its isolated share of the reported slowdown is not established, and no numerical speedup is promised. The owner also approved the two demonstrated pre-existing CI blockers: adapt the floor-navigation smoke to actual container widths and preserve warm header geometry before the first frame.
